soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 — affine-dimension clause
soundness_flags.one_line: Nonempty fiber does not imply dimension |W|-rank(C_W): on a four-cycle, fix the two negative-sign coordinates at zero, put the two positive-sign coordinates in [0,1], and take Cμ=0; the cycle equation forces both uncertain coordinates to zero, so the fiber has affine dimension 0 although the displayed formula gives 1.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 7 — zero-anticipation reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated conditions allow a target cohort with no observed pre-implementation edge, so Cμ=0 and ℓ=u=0 leave its cohort gauge unidentified; Theorem 4 then retains a bounded-support interval rather than reducing to the usual point-identified not-yet-treated ATT functional.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 7 — three-cohort witness
soundness_flags.one_line: The relation a_{4,3}-a_{5,3}=1/2 plus equal radii and weights does not define a unique witness or imply the stated [-3/4,3/4] range without the graph, all fixed coordinates, interval endpoints, μ, and the exact aggregate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 and Theorems 4–6
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exhaustive announced-policy full-law completion is an explicit unresolved construction target, not an assumed causal-attainability premise.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The sharp-region, transshipment, and coverage results are conditional on a positive resolution of the announced-policy completion property.
